There are always many people at the flower market. It takes twenty minutes to get to the city park by bike. Last Friday, Sam and Mia went to the city park. In fact, the old motorbike still has shiny chrome handles.
Sam bought a T-shirt at the shop yesterday. Mia's birthday is in January. Sam thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Don't lose your ticket.
Sam learned a lot about music. The weather was cloudy that day. Sam hopes to visit London one day. White swans glide on the quiet lake.
Sam is reading a book about music. Mia is interested in singing. The city park is one of the best places in the city.
